acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce and classify STATIC Frontier case/witness findings against the same full-base CEM, valid OCM links and actual enrolled-check observations; retain expected conservative findings separately from confirmed defects.
Document or qualify how Go t.Run requirement-case anchors and numeric schema-pin edits associate with material-change/test witnesses; preserve conservative OPEN when evidence is unavailable.

Retain exact source/runtime/profile identities and regression evidence for any admitted fix; do not infer behavioral correctness from structural links or erase the independent check/authority boundaries.
body: Observed profile limitation, not confirmed bug. At typed-argv public integration target c1f4f3d0a8383b78a6ee34cd64123fec41ea0a64/publicbase01f557cb47272d44c1316cc58d2b44529661756f, installed Core1.0.0-rc.1 build163, Tasksdev202, Go1.27.1, canonical CEM119supported/0unknown and six exact t.Run OCM requirement/test links; all14enrolled checks qualified. Each scoped frontier --cem ... --ocm ... --expected-base PUBLIC --target TARGET --json returns exit1 OPEN testMode STATIC. IDX-SNAP-V0-017 gives TEST_NOT_MATCHED and NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE_WITNESS despite the admitted case/schema pin tests; other linked typed-argv scopes give TEST_CLAIM_UNASSOCIATED/material-witness absence. All119 hunks also receive EVIDENCE_SPAN_TOO_BROAD; each scope has SUBJECT_TERM_BOUND_EXCEEDED. These may be intended lexical/static/bounded-adapter limitations, not incorrect runtime behavior. Expected: clearly characterize case/witness/term-bound support so valid OCM links and separately observed passing execution are not misread as Frontier closure. Actual: structurally linked named cases still leave opaque static associations. Exact dedup TEST_CLAIM_UNASSOCIATED/TEST_NOT_MATCHED empty. Evidence /tmp/corvint-parallel-dispatch/issue408-ci-public-frontier-001.json through005.json, issue408-ci-public-report-assessment.json, issue408-ci-public-finish-initial.json, issue408-ci-public-integration-review.md. Maintenance retained the OPEN advisory findings; no Frontier implementation change or extra semantic repair was made.
title: Characterize STATIC Frontier requirement-case and material-witness association limits
